youtube.title: What If You Fell Through A Hole In The Earth? 🌍 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Imagine a hole straight through the Earth. You jump in.

Gravity pulls you down, faster and faster, toward the centre. At the centre you're going thousands of kilometres an hour. Then gravity starts pulling you back, and you slow down on the way up. In the simplest version, you pop out on the other side in about forty minutes. Then you fall back. Forever. Unless someone catches you.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.

#Shorts #physics #space #whatif #thehiddenwhy
